senses.gloss: ch. ch. Alfa = Alef. Cant. R. beg. the poet כד עביד א׳ בית״א when writing alphabetical acrostics. Lam. R. introd. (R. Ḥama b. Ḥ.) מן תלתא תלתא פסוקי בא׳ בית״א belonging to the alphab. acrostics (in Lamentations) of three verses for each letter.; a. fr.
(ἄλφα) Alpha, the first letter of the Greek Alphabet.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 8:1">Men. VIII, 1</cite> <he>א׳ לסולת</he> best quality of flour.
